title: ResetKillSwitchRequest
description: Update payload for KillSwitchWorkflow.reset_killswitch. Dual-control required: approver_id_1 and approver_id_2 must be non-empty and distinct. Validator rejects same-approver. After reset, a configurable cool-down (cfg.reset_cooldown_secs) blocks new entries with KILL_SWITCH_COOLING_DOWN.

note.description: Operator-supplied free-form note recorded in the KillSwitchResetApproved audit event.
